notes: Do not duplicate U1. Existing u1-plan.json has immutable placement (1550,1650) and pins: 1 DRV_DT; 2 DRV_INH; 3 DRV_INL; 4 DRV_FAULT_N; 5 DRV_VDS; 6 3V3_CORE; 7 DRV_SO; 8 DRV_GAIN; 9 DRV_ID1; 10 12V_DRV; 11 DRV_ID2; 12 GND_SYS; 13 SC_MINUS; 14 GND_SYS; 15 GND_SYS; 16 DRV_GL; 17 DRV_GH; 18 SW; 19 BOOT; 20 BUS_BR. This plan follows those exact net names.

F_BUS and F_SC are external inline fuses, not PCB fuse-holder footprints. Route raw BUS_SOURCE through F_BUS to BUS_EXT and raw SC_PLUS through F_SC to SC_FUSED; J_SC_POWER and L_MAIN use SC_FUSED. Keep cell-tap/TLV sensing on raw SC_PLUS. Eaton AMG-80 80A/70VDC/2.5kA is a candidate only; interrupt suitability and coordination require minimum source ESR/fault-current and device SOA review.

Normal braking is first absorbed by the battery and supercapacitor. Dump absorbs surplus; only if both are near full and remaining absorption reserve is insufficient does CAN request regenerative-power limitation. External dump resistor: 1.8ohm +/-1%, at least 1kJ for a 1s pulse; at BUS=42V and Rmin=1.782ohm, Pmax=989.9W and E1s=989.9J. Treat this as a roughly 1kW/1s pulse/thermal budget, not an unlimited continuous rating; supplier pulse curve, cooling, repetition interval and continuous dissipation remain open.
42V is a candidate design BUS upper bound, not a physical clamp guarantee. There is no hardware BUS_OV comparator in this plan and no claim that the 42V downstream limit is protected.

URB4812YMD-10WR3 is a separate 12V module candidate from BUS_EXT, not a shared FOC 12V branch. Local library variants were package/pin mismatches, so U_AUX12 uses a generic symbol and unresolved footprint. Pin map follows manufacturer view: 1 GND_SYS (-Vin), 2 BUS_EXT (+Vin), 3 12V_DRV (+Vo), 4 NP/NC, 5 GND_SYS (return), 6 CTRL left floating. Use a custom PCB footprint from the 25.4mm module drawing; do not substitute a 1x6 header footprint.

5V reuse direction is selected from the existing Hi-Link source to WeAct coreboard VCC5V; exact installed model, wiring and remaining output current are unverified. Do not infer current margin from separate URB4805 candidate.

The 390ohm/2W 12V preload is a candidate: 12^2/390=0.369W at nominal 12V. Verify module minimum-load and thermal requirements before fixing value. External/input/output capacitance limits are also not represented as guaranteed by the provisional bypass capacitors.

Power components and high-current external interfaces are candidates only. No 22uH library inductor met hot-bias/saturation need; keep L_MAIN generic and procure to Lhot>=16uH@80A, Ipk>=100A and DCRhot<=2mohm. The 0.5mohm 6W R2512 shunt library item is not proof of PCB/Kelvin/continuous-80A thermal capability.

QP candidate pinout: pin1 Gate, pin2 Drain, pin3 Source per Littelfuse TO-247 data sheet. IRLB4030: pin1 Gate, pin2 Drain, pin3 Source per Infineon data sheet. MMBT5551: pin1 Base, pin2 Emitter, pin3 Collector per onsemi. Verify selected EasyEDA symbol/device pin mappings before schematic import.

J_BUS_POWER, J_SC_POWER and J_DUMP are generic high-current interfaces: use M6 studs/large-current terminals or separate high-current holes with verified copper/wire; do not substitute small low-current screw-terminal symbols as a current rating.

TLV6700 is only the SC total-voltage comparator; 510kohm/10kohm split top (255k+255k) and 10kohm bottom gives nominal 20.8V. Threshold tolerance, reference shift, wiring/layout and startup/diagnostic behavior remain unapproved.

DRV8161 CSA candidate settings are gain20 (30kohm) and 0.5mohm shunt; U1 SO goes through 22ohm to IMON, then PB1 ADC/COMP1 and PA7 COMP2. COMP DAC threshold, COMP-to-TIM1-break route, polarity and shutdown timing remain unverified.
Coordinates are spacing/layout suggestions only; keep active power loops compact and Kelvin/shunt/TLV references separate. No EDA application, import, ERC, routing or electrical test was run.

Add C_SC_BULK=100uF/35V and C_SC_HF=1uF/50V across SC_FUSED-SC_MINUS. Add two 4.7uF/100V film-capacitor candidates across BUS_BR-GND_SYS; total purchased film-capacitor ripple rating must be at least 30Arms at 100kHz. The generic 4.7uF values do not claim a qualified supplier, ripple rating, footprint, or that the existing 470uF electrolytic alone handles the estimated QH RMS ripple (about 27Arms at 55A and D=0.5). Do not replace these film candidates with small ceramics as if their ripple rating were met.

External fuse candidate source: Eaton AMG-80 product page https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/skuPage.AMG-80.html. The 80A/70VDC/2.5kA ratings do not establish fault interruption suitability; verify minimum source ESR/fault current, cable and semiconductor SOA/coordination.
